2. About Faith Nexus

Where Faith Meets the Future

Faith Nexus is a pan-African platform connecting people and institutions shaping society through faith, media, technology, education, enterprise, leadership and culture.

14–16 April 2027 · Johannesburg, South Africa
Understanding the Platform

What Is Faith Nexus?

Faith Nexus exists at the intersection of faith and the forces shaping the future.

It brings Christian leaders and institutions into meaningful conversation with creators, technologists, educators, entrepreneurs, media professionals, artists, public leaders and emerging voices.

Faith Nexus is not built around a single industry. It is designed as a connected Kingdom ecosystem where relationships can form across sectors that too often operate independently.

The platform creates opportunities for learning, dialogue, collaboration, innovation and long-term relationship-building.

Strategic Purpose

Our Vision

To connect and equip Kingdom voices for greater influence across Africa and the world.

Faith Nexus seeks to strengthen Kingdom voices with deeper foundations, stronger relationships, better tools and wider opportunities.

The goal is not simply to gather people for three days. It is to help build an ecosystem that continues creating value long after the event ends.

Imperative

Why Faith Nexus?

The worlds of media, technology, leadership, culture, education and enterprise are changing rapidly.

Christian leaders and institutions are increasingly being called to engage these environments with greater understanding, creativity, confidence and responsibility.

Faith Nexus creates a place where those conversations can happen together:

  • • A place to recover foundations.
  • • A place to understand change.
  • • And a place to build what comes next.
Theme 01

Roots

Recovering the spiritual, biblical and historical foundations that give Christian influence depth and identity.

Roots asks:
What grounds us?
Theme 02

Revelation

Understanding the changing world of media, technology, culture, communication and leadership.

Revelation asks:
What is changing around us?
Theme 03

Renaissance

Building new ideas, platforms, enterprises, institutions and creative expressions for the future.

Renaissance asks:
What must we now build?

Convened by WCCCS

The World Christian Content Creators Summit (WCCCS) convenes Faith Nexus.

WCCCS brings together Christian creators and communications professionals working across media, storytelling and digital platforms. Faith Nexus expands that conversation into a wider ecosystem that connects faith with technology, leadership, education, enterprise, and culture.
